pages.text: A catalyst binds the molecule it works on with an energy E_b. Too weak and nothing sticks; too strong and nothing leaves: the activity lies on a volcano, highest at E₀. More metal binds a little harder; calcining hotter turns more of it to oxide, harder again - and past the support's limit the grains sinter and the surface collapses.
$(thing)Set$(): Metal loading, Calcination temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Furnace drift: the binding varies by ±0.01 eV·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The furnace is over its rating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A better batch is made faster.
